#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

inline ll read() {
    ll x = 0, f = 1;
    char c = getchar();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') f = -1; c = getchar(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + c - '0'; c = getchar(); }
    return x * f;
}

const ll MOD1 = 1000000007, MOD2 = 998244353, B = 1000000;
ll n, idx, ans;
vector<ll> buckets[7];
ll sum[7];

inline ll mod2(ll x) { return ((x % MOD2) + MOD2) % MOD2; }

void precompute(ll cur, ll depth) {
    ++idx;
    ll val = mod2(idx - cur);
    buckets[depth].push_back(val);
    sum[depth] = (sum[depth] + val) % MOD1;
    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (ll i = 0; i < 10; ++i)
        precompute(cur * 10 + i, depth + 1);
}

void traverse(ll cur) {
    if (cur > n) return;
    
    if (cur * B + (B - 1) <= n && cur * B * 10 > n) {
        ll start = idx;
        for (ll d = 0, mul = 1; d <= 6; ++d, mul *= 10) {
            ll sz = buckets[d].size();
            ll diff = mod2(start - cur * mul);
            ll target = (MOD2 - diff) % MOD2;
            ll pos = lower_bound(buckets[d].begin(), buckets[d].end(), target) - buckets[d].begin();
            ans = (ans + diff * sz % MOD1 + sum[d] - (sz - pos) * MOD1 % MOD1) % MOD1;
            idx += sz;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    ++idx;
    ans = (ans + mod2(idx - cur)) % MOD1;
    for (ll i = 0; i < 10; ++i)
        traverse(cur * 10 + i);
}

int main() {
    n = read();
    precompute(0, 0);
    for (ll i = 0; i <= 6; ++i)
        sort(buckets[i].begin(), buckets[i].end());
    idx = 0;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= 9; ++i)
        traverse(i);
    ans = (ans % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
